technical.summary: ORLY shows strong momentum signals (volume spike, new highs, three white soldiers) with positive RSI/MACD confluence, but trend confirmation is weak (low ADX, price below cloud, moving average misalignment) and overbought conditions suggest caution on swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ORLY shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 33 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (15/100) with historical congressional buys by senior Republican Kevin Hern create contrarian buy signals, though trades are 7+ months old and lack recent news confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (369.92), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring discretionary consumer stocks, with earnings event in 33 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong momentum confluence (volume spike 15x, three white soldiers, new highs, StochRSI cross-up, OBV bullish) with extreme fear sentiment and contrarian congressional buys create tactical entry opportunity near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak trend confirmation (ADX false, price below Ichimoku cloud, no EMA alignment, Hull MA non-bullish), overbought Williams %R, unfavorable macro (VIX crisis, rising dollar, flat yield curve), high earnings risk in 33 days, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction make this a low-probability swing setup.

decision.entry_rationale: While momentum signals (volume spike, three white soldiers, StochRSI cross) and extreme fear sentiment create tactical appeal, weak trend confirmation (ADX false, price below cloud, no EMA alignment) and overbought conditions undermine conviction.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment combined with earnings event in 33 days creates execution risk; macro headwinds (rising dollar, flat yield curve, recession signals) conflict with discretionary sector positioning.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show bullish signals, but fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose; debate winner is bear with high confidence.
